title: About Sabarika
subtitle: The Heart & Soul Behind Sabu Cakes

sections.heading: A Passion Born from Love
sections.content: Hi! I'm Sabarika, a 23-year-old entrepreneur chef and the founder of Sabu Cakes. My journey into the world of baking started from my grandmother's kitchen, where I learned that the secret ingredient to any great cake is love. Today, I pour that same love into every cake I bake for you.

sections.heading: Why Sabu Cakes is Different
sections.content: Every cake at Sabu Cakes is baked fresh to order - no pre-made, frozen, or day-old cakes. I personally oversee each creation, ensuring premium ingredients, perfect textures, and beautiful designs. From classic favorites to innovative Indian fusion cakes, I'm constantly experimenting to bring you unique flavors.

sections.heading: Our Commitment to You
sections.content: When you order from Sabu Cakes, you're not just getting a cake - you're getting a piece of my heart. I understand that cakes are part of your special moments, and I'm honored to be a part of your celebrations. Quality, freshness, and your satisfaction are my top priorities.

values.title: 100% Fresh
values.description: Every cake is baked fresh to order. No compromises on freshness!

values.title: Premium Ingredients
values.description: Only the finest ingredients go into our cakes - real butter, fresh cream, quality chocolate.

values.title: Handcrafted Love
values.description: Each cake is personally crafted with attention to detail and lots of love.

values.title: Custom Creations
values.description: Your dream cake, your way. We love bringing your visions to life!
